clusters.name: Absurd Silence, Searching Souls
clusters.description: Protagonists adrift in an indifferent or incomprehensible world, confronting alienation, arbitrary fate, and the absence of clear meaning. Each book asks how to live, connect, or act with integrity when the larger order offers no answers.
